description: We are The_Martians_66 team, a passionate team of Computer Science and AI students interested in game development, 3D graphics, and innovative technologies. We're creating Mars Mission , an immersive Mars exploration game. Our strengths include programming, problem-solving, creativity, and teamwork. We're looking for motivated members skilled in game development, Blender, UI/UX, or programming. Join us to learn, collaborate, and bring exciting ideas to life!
